info.title: AgriCore API
info.description:
AgriCore is a portfolio demonstration built to show engineering work. It is not a working farm operations service, no real sensor, machine or field is connected to it, and nobody is monitoring the alerts it raises. Do not use it to run an actual farm.

Every schema in this document is generated from the Zod schemas in packages/contracts, which are the same definitions the server validates against.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Generated by the client when the countdown starts, not when the request is sent, so a crash mid-countdown still deduplicates on retry. Reusing a key with a different body is a 409.
